title: 第8章 兴奋的楚生第9章 震撼
lines: 楚生之前还好奇放鱼的水桶怎么这么大，案板怎么有两米多长，杀鱼刀怎么有三把？
现在，他全明白了。
这鱼舱里的鱼，绝对不正常！
他再将目光聚焦在屠宰区，才发现方才看到的白毛猪竟然不是普通的家猪，獠牙比老虎的还尖锐。
回想方才跟着场主陈坤所看到的画面，鸡、鸭、鹅、猪、牛、羊似乎都有点不正常。
七彩羽毛的鸡，似乎在交流的鸭，摆出战斗姿势的鹅……
变异？
还是妖？
楚生眼神兴奋起来，换成一把厚重的斩骨刀，一刀砸向水桶中鲶鱼头……
果然，这一条大鱼抵得上两条寻常的鱼。
见到鱼舱开口还没有出大鱼，楚生将木桶中的五条鱼三下解决掉，又收割0.5点杀戮值。
【姓名：楚生】
【杀戮值：6】
【修为进度：淬皮境初阶70100】
【境界：未激活】
【武技：未激活】
杀了7条鱼，就斩获了0.8点杀戮值，快比得上杀一个人了。
杀人，还得遮遮掩掩，担心被官府发现，害怕对方报复。
值当，太值当了！
杀一百条？
这怎么够！
出鱼口再次滑出一条人头大小的黑鱼。
楚生干劲十足，直接一拳砸其脑部，然后将其提出水桶，平放在宽敞的案板上，再次分尸……
壮实青年粗眉紧皱，没想到新来的少年不仅不犯恶心，反而亢奋地投入杀鱼之中，不由得有些烦躁。
中心区域的屠宰区中，几个肌肉线条炸裂的壮汉，用抹布擦拭血刃，纷纷议论起来。
“老吴，这家伙比起你之前，丝毫不差啊！”
“的确，老吴天生蛮力，一天就杀了一百五十条，也不知道这新来的小子今天可以杀多少条。”
“话说你们发现没有，这小子怎么越杀越兴奋，而且速度不减反增，比之前的老吴猛多了。”
议论声中，一个黄铜皮肤、青色胡须的大高个抬眼看向水产区，眼眸深邃，寒气逼人，一看就让人感受到一股杀意。
大高个看到杀鱼亢奋的楚生，欣赏道：“有点意思，是个好苗子，估计老陈已经在关注了吧！”
“当初的我，的确不如他！”
嘶！
屠宰区其他人，都倒吸了一口凉气。
就连烧水的伙夫都停下来，看向众人口中的老吴，一脸不敢相信。
老吴，居然说他不如新来的那个小子？
老吴一入屠宰场就暴露其嗜血的本性，对杀戮格外狂热，整日沉迷其中，一个月的时间就成为正式屠夫，能独自击杀一头化妖期牲畜。
后面更是受到场主陈一手的重点培养，如今在屠宰场，已然成为除了场主之外地位最高的人。
场主陈坤，传闻曾经是武者，一手刀法十分了得，哪怕因对敌失去一臂沦落成屠宰场场主，其威名仍让这些屠夫们由衷敬畏。
content_en:
Chu Sheng had previously wondered why the bucket for the fish was so big, why the chopping board was more than two meters long, and why there were three fish-killing knives.
Now, he understood it all.
The fish in this fish cabin are definitely not normal!
He focused his attention on the slaughter area again, only to realize that the white-haired pig he had just seen was no ordinary domestic pig. Its tusks were sharper than those of a tiger.
Recalling what I just saw with the owner Chen Kun, the chickens, ducks, geese, pigs, cows, and sheep all seemed a little abnormal.
Chickens with colorful feathers, ducks that seem to be communicating, geese in fighting postures...
Mutation?
Or a demon?
Chu Sheng's eyes became excited, he changed to a heavy bone-cutting knife, and hit the catfish head in the bucket with one blow...
[Kill value +0.2]
Sure enough, this big fish is worth two ordinary fish.
Seeing that no big fish had come out of the fish cabin opening, Chu Sheng killed the five fish in the barrel three times and gained another 0.5 kill points.
[Name: Chu Sheng]
[Kill value: 6]
[Qi and blood: 25.7]
[Cultivation Progress: Skin Tempering Realm Beginner Level 70100]
[Exercise: "Five Elements Technique" 50100]
[Realm: Inactive]
[Martial skills: not activated]
After killing 7 fish, you gain 0.8 kill points, which is almost as good as killing one person.
When killing someone, you have to cover it up for fear of being discovered by the government and fear of retaliation.
It’s worth it, so worth it!
Kill a hundred?
How is this enough!
A black fish the size of a human head slipped out of the fish outlet again.
Chu Sheng was so motivated that he punched his head directly, then lifted him out of the bucket, placed him flat on the spacious chopping board, and cut his body into pieces again...
The sturdy young man frowned. Unexpectedly, the new boy not only did not feel disgusted, but also devoted himself to killing fish excitedly. He couldn't help but feel a little irritated.
In the slaughter area in the center, several strong men with bursting muscles wiped the bloody blades with rags and started talking.
"Old Wu, this guy is no worse than you were before!"
"Indeed, Old Wu was born with brute strength. He killed one hundred and fifty in one day. I don't know how many this new kid can kill today."
"Have you noticed how this kid gets more and more excited the more he kills, and his speed increases instead of decreasing? He is much more powerful than the old Wu before."
In the midst of the discussion, a tall man with brass skin and a green beard raised his eyes to the aquatic product area. His eyes were deep and cold, and one could feel a murderous intent at the first glance.
The tall man saw Chu Sheng who was excited about killing fish and admired it: "It's quite interesting. It's a good idea. I guess Old Chen is already paying attention to it!"
"The me back then was indeed not as good as him!"
Hiss!
Everyone else in the slaughter area gasped.
Even the cook who was boiling water stopped and looked at Lao Wu, whom everyone was talking about, with expressions of disbelief.
Old Wu actually said that he was not as good as the new kid?
As soon as Lao Wu entered the slaughterhouse, his bloodthirsty nature was exposed. He was extremely fanatical about killing and indulged in it all day long. Within a month, he became an official butcher and could kill an animal in the demon state alone.
Later, he was trained intensively by the owner Chen Yishou, and now he has become the highest-status person in the slaughterhouse besides the owner.
The owner of the farm, Chen Kun, was rumored to have been a warrior, and his sword skills were very good. Even though he lost an arm to the enemy and became the owner of the slaughterhouse, his reputation still made the butchers sincerely awe him.
title_en: Chapter 8 Excited Chu Sheng Chapter 9 Shock
